name: project-streamscale
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: portfolio project cover for a premium dark software-development agency website template.
Style/medium: sophisticated clean premium product art, photorealistic silver hardware with crisp conceptual screen interfaces, dark charcoal setting, small acid-lime accents.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 4:3 composition, balanced complete devices with generous margin; keep key product interfaces legible at card size.
Constraints: representative product concept mockup, not a verified screenshot; no invented performance numbers, user counts, extra page headings, captions, watermarks, or third-party branding.
Primary request: StreamScale: a large widescreen dark streaming interface on a sleek silver monitor, cinematic original landscape poster cards showing imagined scenery, dark video-catalog UI, small streaming player and subtle admin-dashboard cue. No Netflix logo and no copyrighted film posters.
